name: core-links
description: Links, the core's typed links: link and unlink, links a create gives (every required one among them), the targets field, links pinned to a revision or a release, with the target's latest and their staleness, the delete of a target (refused for a required link, cleared for an optional one, as the caller), the schema-level listLinked, reads as the caller, and its config rules.

instanceBehaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

targets.description: The links the instance holds, by name: each target's schema and id, and for a pinned link the revision or the release it records, the target's latest and whether the target has moved past it; for a many-valued link, a list of them in the order they were linked. Absent when the instance holds none.

behaviors.name: Links
behaviors.description: Named links from the instance to instances of the schemas its config names, set by link or given at create: each holds one target, or with many a list of them. A pinned link records the target's revision (its schema composes Revisions) or its release (its schema composes Branches), and reports the target's latest beside it and whether the target has moved past it. A required link is given at create, can be moved to another target but not unlinked, and the delete of its target is refused; a required many-valued link keeps at least one target, and only its last target's delete is refused. A deleted target leaves every link that holds it.
behaviors.summary: Each Cook links to other instances by name: note to Note (pinned to a release) and recipe to Recipe (pinned to a release). A link pinned to a release records the target's release; behaviors.Links.targets gives the target's latest beside it and says stale once the target has released again.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The links the instance holds, by name: each target's schema and id, and for a pinned link the revision or the release it records, the target's latest and whether the target has moved past it; for a many-valued link, a list of them in the order they were linked. Absent when the instance holds none.

vetoes.description: A link pinned to a revision, by link or a create's links, to a target that has no revision to pin yet.
A link pinned to a release, by link or a create's links, to a target that has not been released yet.
unlink of a required link, which link moves and nothing unlinks, or of the last target of a required many-valued link.
The delete of an instance a required link points at, whoever the caller; for a many-valued link, of its last target.
link of a new target to a many-valued link that holds its max.
unlink of a target the link does not hold.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Cook
operations.description: Creates a Cook: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given. behaviors gives its behaviors their create parameters (Links), which hold from the create on.

behaviors.description: Each behavior's create parameters, by behavior name; they hold from the create on, in its transaction

Links.description: The links the instance holds from its create, by name, each held to link's rules.

note.description: The Note instance note points at: its id, or an object with its id and the release to record, its latest when absent.

release.description: The target's release to record, one it has had.

recipe.description: The Recipe instance recipe points at: its id, or an object with its id and the release to record, its latest when absent.

release.description: The target's release to record, one it has had.

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Cook: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. behaviors gives Links their create parameters, which hold from the create on. behaviors.Links gives the links from the create, by name (note and recipe): each the target's id, or { id, release } for note and recipe.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

errors.description: Links: A link pinned to a release, by link or a create's links, to a target that has not been released yet.
errors.commonCorrection: Wait until the target has been released, or link a target that has.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Cook
operations.description: Returns the Cook with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Cook to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Cook instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Cook
operations.description: Lists Cook instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Cook instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Cook
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Cook with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Cook

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Cook with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete Cook
operations.description: Deletes the Cook with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Cook with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

operations.name: link
operations.title: Cook: link
operations.description: Points a link at an instance of its schema, replacing the target it had; a many-valued link adds the instance to its list, or pins again one it holds. A pinned link records the target's latest revision or release, or the one given.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

name.description: The link's name in the config.

release.description: For a link pinned to a release, the target's release to record, one it has had; its latest when absent.

revision.description: For a link pinned to a revision, the target's revision to record, one it has had; its latest when absent.

release.description: The target's release a link pinned to a release records.

revision.description: The target's revision a link pinned to a revision records.

guidance.useWhen: Use to point note or recipe at an instance of its schema, moving it when it is set. note and recipe record the target's latest release, or the one given.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use at create; give the links in behaviors.Links instead.
guidance.success: Returns the link: its name, schema, id and the revision or release a pinned link records.

errors.description: Links: A link pinned to a release, by link or a create's links, to a target that has not been released yet.
errors.commonCorrection: Wait until the target has been released, or link a target that has.

operations.name: unlink
operations.title: Cook: unlink
operations.description: Clears an optional link, or removes one target of a many-valued link. A required link cannot be unlinked, only moved, and a required many-valued link keeps at least one target.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

id.description: The target to remove, which a many-valued link needs; for a link that holds one target, the one it must hold.

name.description: The link's name in the config.

guidance.useWhen: Use to clear note or recipe.
guidance.success: Returns the link as it was.

operations.name: listLinked
operations.title: Cook: listLinked
operations.description: Lists the instances of this schema whose link points at an instance, in the order the links were made, one page at a time; for a pinned link, with the revision or the release each records, the target's latest and whether the target has moved past it.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many instances; 50 when absent.

name.description: The link's name in the config.

stale.description: Only the pinned links whose target has moved past the revision or the release they record.

id.description: The id of the instance that holds the link.

latest.description: The target's latest revision or release, of the kind the link pins.

release.description: The target's release a link pinned to a release records.

revision.description: The target's revision a link pinned to a revision records.

stale.description: Whether the target has moved past the one the link records.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

guidance.useWhen: Use to find the Cook instances whose link points at a target. With stale true, only the pinned ones the target has moved past.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.
